question: Padma Bhushan 2022, awardee _________ is a Hindustani Classical musician.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashid Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rashid Khan is a renowned Hindustani classical musician.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 2022.
 
• The Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in India.
 
• Rashid Khan is famous for his contributions to the field of Hindustani classical music.
 
• He has received numerous accolades and recognition for his musical talents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Bhushan**

 
 
• The Padma Bhushan is one of the highest civilian honors in India, awarded for distinguished service of a high order in any field.
 
• It is awarded by the Government of India.
 
• Recipients of the Padma Bhushan are announced every year on Republic Day.
 
 
 
• **Hindustani Classical Music**
 
 
• It is a tradition of Indian classical music originating from the northern regions of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• This music genre is known for its complex ragas and talas.
 
• Hindustani classical music has a rich history and has been influenced by various cultures and traditions over the centuries.
 
 
 
• **Other Padma Bhushan Awardees**
 
 
• Madhuri Barthwal, a musicologist and folk singer, was also honored with the Padma Bhushan in 2022.
 
• Victor Banerjee, an acclaimed Indian actor, received the Padma Bhushan for his contributions to Indian cinema.
 
• Geeta Chandran, a celebrated Bharatanatyam dancer, was another recipient of the Padma Bhushan in 2022.
